chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: The Sunset cabaret in Chicago
summary: After Cleveland he went into the Sunset in Chicago, a cabaret with variety acts and stars like Louis Armstrong and Earl Hines.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Let's go back now until the time you were about 26 -- in your 20's. What kind of entertainment was going on? There were acts, there must have been different types of tap dancing going on, there was different kinds of music, different kinds of shows.
Tell me what you want to know about. Tell me and see if I know it, maybe I don't know it.
Well, you were in cabarets, right? There must have been some --
Well you mentioned the cabaret you were in, I think it was Chicago, wasn't it? It was in Cleveland that you were in a cabaret.
I decided I would go into cabaret. After I went to Cleveland I decided I'd go to cabaret so I went into the Sunset in Chicago.
Was this considered vaudeville at this point --
No, it was cabaret. Not vaudeville, but they had variety acts there and this was the place where we had Louis Armstrong, Earl Hines, Zutty Singleton, May Alix, singer, Jazz Lips Richardson.
Were you considered a variety act, Buck and Bubbles?
